title: The entry's detail page has no Delete; Edit Library Part shows Delete bottom left, Save right, no Cancel
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-E1 (Part Library entry with no part behind it) and QAPL-T1 (tracked part with stock, so its entry is in use). DevTools Network tab open. Light theme, window 1440 px.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library (parts_nav_catalog) > search "QAPL-E1" > click its row.
  2. Click the pencil beside the entry's name (button_edit_catalogue_part).
  3. Change the Description to "QAPL-E1 X-test", then close the window with the X in its title row.
  4. Click the pencil again.
  5. Open QAPL-T1's entry from the Part Library list and click its pencil.
custom_expected:
1. The entry's detail page opens (/parts-catalogue/{id}). There is no Delete button anywhere on the detail page.
  2. The window titled "Edit Library Part" opens. Footer: Delete (button_delete_library_part) at the bottom left, Save (button_save_library_part) at the right, and no Cancel button.
  3. The window closes without saving: no POST /api/parts-catalogue/change-catalogue-part in Network, and the detail page still shows the original description.
  4. The window shows the saved description, not "QAPL-E1 X-test".
  5. QAPL-T1's detail page has no Delete either; its Edit Library Part window has the same footer: Delete bottom left (disabled, because a part uses the entry), Save at the right, no Cancel.
